notes.title: Embark on a New Adventure with Us: SirKwitz is Launched!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce the launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2776550/SirKwitz]SirKwitz[/url], our innovative educational FREE game designed to make programming accessible and enjoyable. Whether you’re young or just young at heart, SirKwitz is here to demystify coding through engaging puzzles and intuitive gameplay.
[i]
Kwitz is a microbot from GPU Town - a very important sector for the citizens of Dataterra. He works in a small capacitor on the first block. The day starts as it always does - a short meet-up with his co-workers, stacks meeting and he’s off to his call stack:
- Next task: “deliver pointers to cache - Core level 28”
As he’s getting out of his capacitor, a power surge engulfs the whole sector. Soon enough, the emergency power supply boots up and Kwitz realizes he’s the only micro that isn’t stuck in his capacitor - all pathways seem sectioned by shorted circuits, with no one else to restore them. So... Off he goes![/i]

This is how the adventures of our character begin. “SirKwitz” is an introductory educational game designed to demystify the fundamentals of programming and introduce players to the world of coding. This beginner-friendly game is a suitable entry point for young people and young adults new to the field, offering a hands-on approach to learning basic programming, through a series of engaging puzzles.

[b]The Fun Path to Programming[/b]
The impact of games in the educational field is no longer a novelty, but when it comes to programming, it may seem difficult to translate basic concepts into engaging gameplay. “SirKwitz” is a beginner-friendly educational game striving to do exactly this, to introduce players to the fundamentals of this field in an entertaining manner. 

“SirKwitz” combines learning with enjoyable gameplay, featuring a simple yet intuitive UI used to puppeteer a robot which will help learners translate programming concepts into instant action. By solving 28 puzzles, players become acquainted to the very core concepts behind programming: base logic, loops, orientation, sequences, and debugging.

The game focuses on developing essential skills for budding programmers, such as problem analysis, spatial orientation, logic, and computational thinking, along with fostering attributes like focus and perseverance.

[b]Where Can the Game Be Played?[/b]
“SirKwitz” is available in English, Italian, Romanian, Lithuanian and Russian, for free on:

notes.title: Arhaekon major update: Version 0.4 Released!
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes - Version 0.4[/b]

[b]Major Changes:[/b]

[u]Overhauled Stats & Leveling System:[/u]
•	Level bonuses for allied units will no longer be automated.
•	Each level-up will grant 1 stat point to be distributed by the player.
•	The bonuses granted by stat points vary depending on the unit's base class.

[u]Overhauled Augments System:[/u]
•	The maximum number of augment sockets has been reduced from 5 to 3 to emphasize choice and tradeoff rather than stacking.
•	Substantially buffed augment bonuses, especially at low levels.

[u]Overhauled Tutorial/Help System:[/u]
•	Implemented a completely new tutorial system that walks the player through the tutorial level, first combat, and town UI.
•	Implemented a faster help system structured more like a Cheatsheet rather than an instructional manual.

[b]Other Major Changes:[/b]

•	All combat-related values are now represented as larger numbers to improve readability and eliminate confusion (e.g., 10% of 33 is 3.3 but was still displayed as 3, which was confusing). Adjusted all content accordingly.
•	All damage output was multiplied to increase the pace of combat, requiring players to rethink some strategies.
•	Reduced progress required for completing regions from 6 to 4, with the exception of some notable regions which will be relevant in the future.
•	Rewrote all lore, reducing its size and scope, and updated location and unit names accordingly to ensure feasibility of planned localization efforts.
•	Suffering a defeat in a battle will now teleport you to town. A world turn will be counted and the units that have died will stay that way.

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]

•	UI:
•	Inventory is no longer locked while the loot window is open, allowing players to trade-off loot items for inventory items.
•	Increased mod icons (buffs/debuffs) to bring them in line with other previously increased icon sizes.

[u]Regions & Dungeons:[/u]
•	Xenium Mines and Caves regions should now always be level 1, as will the encounters, regardless of encounter rarity.
•	The default behavior of auto-adjusting the level of regions according to the average formation level will now only kick in after the two starting regions.
•	Added color-coded shimmer to indicate encounter rarity.
•	Buffed many of the ritual rites.
•	Reduced the number of altars in dungeons and increased their significance.

[u]Battle:[/u]
•	Using "wait" now grants instant stamina regeneration equal to its positive initial value. The initial value is set when entering battle, meaning it can be affected by rituals or curses but cannot be further modified during the encounter. However, if when initiating the encounter this value is negative or 0, this functionality will be ignored.
•	The enemy's portrait will now be displayed on the right side during the enemy's turn.

[u]Settings:[/u]
•	Added Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty settings upon starting a new game. This can only be changed when starting a new game.
•	Added a gamma option in settings. This setting applies instantly and does not require confirmation.

[u]MISC:[/u]
•	Increased max bound units in Refugee Camp from 6-12 to 8-16.
•	Added short descriptions of Purgatory and Medial Ward effects.
•	Updated facility tooltips to reflect recent changes.
•	Combat music should now only be drums, without the theme.
•	Redesigned sections of the tutorial map to accommodate lore and tutorial system changes.
•	Improved performance in battle maps and for some of the combat units.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•	Fixed fps drops on some tier 2 army compositions
•	Fixed cloth simulation on Prospherisors (enemy encounters).
•	Fixed a rare occurrence of battle-locks.
•	Fixed rendering of some decals present in some of the dungeons.
•	Fixed cases where widgets would linger on the screen while moving.
•	Fixed some UI SFX not playing as intended.
•	Fixed hair not rendering as intended in some situations.
•	Fixed a bug where units wouldn't be properly committed to purgatory/status would not instantly update.
•	Fixed building upgrade buttons not updating along with currency changes as intended.
•	Fixed augment socket locks not updating along with currency changes as intended.
•	Fixed many other UI updates not working as intended in certain cases.
•	Fixed a bug allowing movement while the loot window is open in certain conditions.
•	Fixed texture showing up as pixelated when opening locks.

notes.title: Arhaekon version 0.30
notes.content:
[b]Patch notes:[/b]

- Updated Engine
- Various performance optimizations
- Removed vsync being enabled by default (in users with 60hz monitors using higher-dpi/gaming mice, this setting made mouse movements feel sluggish, since the game itself would be capped at 60fps. The setting can still be enabled for users that prefer to have vsync on).
- Removed background blurs when opening various windows (this prevented seeing the resource amounts which might be relevant sometimes). It has been replaced with a darken film.
- Improved tutorial by adding smaller popups and tips as the player progresses while still keeping the larger, "wordier" help available.
- The formation window will always open before entering dungeons (this is to prevent the prevalent situations in which players would venture forth with incomplete formations, die, deem the game impossible to beat and quit)
- The vault will be open by default when revisiting town (this is to facilitate item transfers without having to explicitly open the vault every time)

notes.title: Arhaekon Dev Diary #17 – Patch 0.25 Brings Exciting Major Changes
notes.content:
Explorers of Arhaekon,


•	*This patch requires starting a new game since core game mechanics have changed. This means savegame files from previous versions will no longer be compatible with version 0.25!


[b]Major changes & content additions:[/b]
•	Redesigned the unit upgrade system. Unit upgrade requirements will now be achieved through expeditions - a new system which also required a major change in the way currency is handled.
•	Expeditions' mechanics heavily rely on currency management, specifically refugee-favor balancing. This is also intended to increase the drive to both find refugees and make consistent use of altars.
•	Running an expedition will trigger autosave! This is meant to prevent endless reloading of the last save and re-running the expedition until it succeeds.


[b]Changes:[/b]
•	Refugee encounters will only contain "refugees". The specific types of refugees (Clerics, Scholars, Craftsmen & Peasants) as well as the materials that could be found in such encounters are removed from the game for now.
•	Ritual rites now have an additional use: to increase Expedition chances. Rituals performed in such a way will not grant any bonuses to the current formation and there is no limit to the number of rituals that can be performed/world turn.
•	The two starting units have had their initial level increased to 3 (previously 1) to increase survivability and help smoothen the difficulty curve.
•	Enemy units should now scale better with levels (the per-level bonuses they receive has been slightly increased across the board).
•	Added 4 crafting recipes, readjusted most ingredient requirements. This is meant to recuperate some value for collectible drops (e.g. ritual rite drops that already exist in the compendium). More similar changes will follow.
•	Clicking anywhere previewing looted items that can be read/previewed by right-clicking them will now close the preview - removed the close button for such widgets.
•	Consumables no longer require adding to the hotbar before consuming, they can now be clicked directly within the loot widget.
•	Improved readability of floating widgets when applying modifiers to formation members - through consumables or curses.
•	Added floating widgets with received bonuses after performing rit.
•	All region levels will now be recomputed upon opening the atlas (previously computed at the end of a turn). This change is meant to reduce discrepancies in levels and offer the possibility to reduce difficulty by abusing the average of Owned Units prior to entering a region.
•	Maximum bound units reduced to 8-14 (previously 10-16) for refugee camp levels 1-5.
•	Refugee camp upgrades now grant additional benefits from level 3 onwards.
•	Level 5 refugee camp now grants a random additional tier 2 recruit from the types for which expedition conditions have been met.
•	Slightly Reduced maximum HP value ranges for Augments to prevent ridiculous bonuses in rare occasions when the same stat was rolled multiple times with maximum values, resulting in cumulative effects (e.g. magic low-level augment granting 32% max health because of lucky cumulative max roll of 16%x2).
•	Adjusted Refugee Camp, Purgatorium and Medical Ward upgrade costs ramping.
•	Adjusted some tier 2 unit stats to balance for tier level translations.
•	Enemy units will now be flagged with a red circle when selected to better differentiate them from allied units.


[b]Fixes:[/b]
•	Fixed graphical glitches related to floating UI elements
•	Fixed consumable values not properly scaling with rarity
•	Fixed container curses applying proportional debuffs instead of flat for non-percentage stats
•	Fixed cases of units spawning on top of each other in battle
•	Fixed AI rogues using divert while already having defended status
•	Fixed wrong transferring of augment bonuses upon upgrading units to tier 2
Explore and enjoy these new features and fixes in Patch 0.25!




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41902749/f167a1bbe29d94b7dbc58cea272ed02c1e4b777e.jpg[/img]

•	Introduced a unit roster limit to avoid abusing average encounter levels by bloating the roster with level 1 units. Upgrading the Refugee Camp will now also increase maximum roster size.
•	Reworked ritual rites by regulating & balancing costs and benefits & added 17 new ritual rites. Ritual rites already found will continue as legacy versions and will not be overwritten.

[b]
Changes:[/b]
•	Loot table is now more closely linked to container or encounter rarity.
•	Toned down curses from opening containers.
•	Increased dungeon enemy chasing speed.
•	Improved AI defender-rogue synergy.
•	Improved AI targeting & decision-making.
•	Improved description of certain skills for more information.
•	Rogue's harass skill no longer ignores block.
•	Reduced Insectoid Guard's damage to 3-7.
•	Increased minimum altar sacrifice costs to 3.
•	Added information text for sanctum when no ritual rites are available.
•	Floating widgets from dying units are now removed as soon as the killing blow lands.
•	Updated help file.

[b]
Fixes:[/b]
•	Fixed some cases where item crafting did not accurately update inventory.
•	Fixed rare cases where allied units would spawn overlapped.
•	Fixed currency display not updating in all cases.
•	Fixed swap being triggered by dropping a formation unit into the roster.
•	Fixed cases where enemy reciprocal diverts invalidated damage taking, locking combat.
•	Fixed rare cases where loot containers contained neither loot nor a curse.
•	Fixed rare instances of dungeons failing to generate.
•	Fixed cases of enemies' "funky rotations".
•	Fixed VFX for Skyndi Shaman's heal skill.
•	Fixed instances where life was displayed as 0 while the unit was still alive.
•	Fixed scriptorium books displaying wrong passages.
•	Fixed TAB key interfering with UI navigation.
•	Fixed cases of enemies not resetting aggro after opening containers.
•	Fixed rare cases of AI units locking turn.
•	Fixed some UI scaling issues on uncommon resolutions.
•	Fixed misfiring hovering effects while widgets are open.
•	Fixed Mage's transfusion ability granting less stamina regen than intended.
•	Fixed spamming skill hotkeys for abilities not requiring a target.
•	Fixed lingering changes from the last session when starting a new game.
•	Fixed UV fighting in Tundra dungeon floor.
•	Fixed cases of shadow artifacts when hitting units.
•	Fixed mismatch of units' names and stats when dragging units around in formation view.
•	Fixed socketing augments removing ritual rites' effects.
•	Fixed rare cases of recruits not having a name.
•	Fixed found book verses not saving.
•	Fixed a bug regarding overlapping home UIs after loading a game.
•	Fixed broken text layout in some widgets.
•	Fixed Cleric class AI attempting to swap to unprotected back row.
•	Fixed bugged scrollbar graphics.

More updates and improvements to come in Arhaekon!

notes.title: Arhaekon Dev Diary #7 - 0.15 Patch notes - Changes and updates
notes.content:
Hello Arhaekon community,

You might have noticed it's been a while since our last update. But don't worry, we haven't been idle. In fact, we've been more active than ever, working tirelessly behind the scenes to elevate Arhaekon to new heights.

Over the past months, our dedicated team has been deeply focused on enhancing, refining, and expanding the game. We believe in quality first, and every minute of this time has been spent on bringing you a more immersive, challenging, and captivating Arhaekon experience.

Now, we're thrilled to start sharing the fruits of our labour with you. In the coming days and weeks, you'll see a series of posts detailing all the exciting changes, improvements, and additions we've made. From gameplay enhancements to new features, we can't wait to show you what we've been up to.


[b]Changes:[/b]

Added literal rarity[list]
[*]  displays
[*] Removed needless "show more details" from unit details window
[*] Removed automatic regens at the end of battle
[*] Changed misleading one-way-door by replacing with a more obvious mesh in Deeproot Forest and Crossroads biomes
[*] Changed percentage bonuses on augments to bring closer to flat bonuses
[*] Changed flat bonuses on augments to better fit minimum values at level 1, lowering their bonuses as they increase in level
[*] Reduced consumable bonuses as they made attrition mechanics a joke
[*] Increased enemy base damage roughly by 10%
[*] Improved minimap utility. This is temporary until I find a more useful minimap solution.
[*] Added help information regarding readable loot which does not require inventory space. This can be read by right
[/list]-clicking on the items straight within the loot widget.


[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed panning on Atlas map
[*] Fixed collision on Frozen Lake's lock door frames
[*] Fixed discrepancies between stats while in combat and before/after
[*] Fixed battles being able to occur through walls  
[/list]

notes.title: Arhaekon Dev Diary #6 - The Mage
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41902749/01a4aca012035e0bc9c22706096afc2bfe84c82b.png[/img]

[b]Class: [/b]Mage

[b]Strengths:[/b]
- Strong AOE damage
- Moderate health and mana pool
- Ability to inflict ailments to enemy units

[b]Weaknesses:[/b]
- High mana cost of abilities
- Might become priority target
- Certain skills locked to melee row

[b]Signature Ability:[/b] [i]Transfusion[/i]
- Attack an ally. 10% of damage dealt, multiplied by adjacent units, will be granted as stamina regeneration to adjacent units for 3 turns.

[b]Signature melee attack effect:[/b]
- Critical strikes can inflict ailments to enemy units.

[b]Other skills:[/b]
- [i]Empower[/i] - Increases critical strike chance by 10% for every adjacent ally. Inflicts Crazed!
- [i]Syphon[/i] - Steal life from an enemy with a successful hit. Blocked hits will grant stamina instead. If the target unit dies, poison will be leeched instead.
- [i]Retrovert[/i] - Inverses an enemy unit's life and stamina for 1 turn. Requires melee range

notes.title: Arhaekon Dev Diary #5 - The Thug
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41902749/116f0ec73a12db22588b4e3bc6463691022bf06b.png[/img]


[b]Class: [/b]Rogue

[b]Strengths:[/b]
- Able to attack both melee and ranged rows
- Tactics based, damage buffs on positioning
- Consistent damage

[b]Weaknesses:[/b]

- Slightly lower health pool

[b]Signature Ability:[/b] [i]Divert[/i]

[b]Other skills:[/b]
- [i]Throwing Knives[/i] - Ranged attack dealing 50% of damage.
- [i]Harass[/i] - Deals damage to stamina instead with 10% increased chance of critical strike..
- [i]Adapt[/i] - Become adapted for 3 turns. Adapted grants 1 defense for every adjacent defender, 10% critical strike chance for every adjacent cleric and 25% critical strike multiplier for every adjacent mage.

notes.title: Arhaekon Dev Diary #4 - The Scout
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41902749/b45456dc17516c02ef6f67a1bdc23bbd5611dd5f.png[/img]

[b]Class:[/b] Rogue

[b]Strengths:[/b]
- Ability to attack from ranged row, providing protection from the melee row
- Tactics based, damage buffs on positioning
- Potentially high damage
- High crit chance

[b]Weaknesses:[/b]
- Lower health pool
- Inconsistent damage
- Moderate-high cost of abilities

[b]Signature Ability:[/b] [i]Divert[/i]
- Diverts attacks to another friendly unit. Effects do not expire unless the target changes or either one of the units die.

[b]Other skills:[/b]
- [i]Suppress[/i] - If the hit is successful, damage dealt lingers as negative stamina regeneration for 3 turns. Deals 50% of base damage.
- [i]Off-Guard[/i] - Deals base damage. Ignores block
- [i]Intercept[/i] - Mark an enemy unit. The scout will preemptively attack the unit every time it performs an action. Effects do not expire unless the target changes or either one of the units die. Lack of stamina will prevent interception.

notes.title: Arhaekon Dev Diary #3 - The Cleric
notes.content:
[i]”Praise, oh daughter of Ivelis, her divine body shown in every vernal offshoot! Hers is the Treasury of creatures and you shall protect her kingdom, that is the Kingdom of Light and Life… ”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41902749/5858d5b400fa421fe58ba5162821a7b4e617b159.jpg[/img]


[b]Class:[/b] Cleric

[b]Strengths:[/b]
- Catered towards healing and buffs
- Moderate stamina
- Consistent stamina regeneration

[b]Weaknesses:[/b]
- Abysmal damage
- Low health pool 
- Priority target for the enemies

[b]Signature Ability:[/b] [i]Divine Patronage[/i]
- Retaliate with Smite every time the target unit is attacked. In this case, smite will only heal the target unit. Effects do not expire unless the target changes or either one of the units die.

[b]Other skills:[/b]
- [i]Smite[/i] - Successful hits heal a random ally by 50% of damage dealt.
- [i]Heal[/i] - Heals friendly adjacent unit.
- [i]Cure[/i] - Removes a random ailment from the target. If the picked ailment is low health or stamina, they will be recovered above the threshold.
- [i]Sacred Ward[/i] - Adds the Cleric's attack rating as defense to all adjacent units.

notes.title: Arhaekon Dev Diary #2 - The Warrior
notes.content:
[i]"They do breed them tough up in the Frozen North; they are bled by harsh gods who demand of them never to remove their masks, unless taken to the bone yard."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41902749/d57593b5667194c1429f82b0fd412ff8ed2f7838.jpg[/img]


[b]Class:[/b] [i]Defender[/i]

[b]Strengths:[/b]
- High survivability due to block chance
- Tailored around protecting allies in various ways
- High stamina

[b]Weaknesses:[/b]
- Lower damage
- Susceptible to stamina damage
- Low stamina regeneration given the large pool & constant damage.

[b]Signature Ability:[/b] [i]Defend[/i]
- Take damage instead of an ally unit

[b]Signature melee attack effect:[/b]
- Successful (unblocked) critical hits will either knockback or stun target

[b]Other skills:[/b]
- [i]Throw weapon[/i] - Attacker looses its weapon for one turn - skills requiring one will be disabled for a duration
- [i]Last resort[/i] - Damage bonus for this attack scales negatively with energy.
- [i]Battle cry[/i] - Grants X% of the caster's defense as attack to all adjacent allies.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

You can find here some relevant information to start with:

[b]What's the current stage of development[/b]
We're currently developing the tutorial level.

[b]What do we have so far?[/b]
Almost everything listed in the Early Access features' list has been implemented and tested internally - we just need to iterate on content + story, and then - hopefully - more of you will chime in and help with bug reports during EA.

[b]Any ETA on the EA release[/b]
At the moment, no. We don't want to make promises we cannot keep, but it's getting closer. We, too, want to release as fast as possible, but we want the release to be of enjoyable quality!

[b]Will there be any demo released for this game?[/b]
We haven't yet decided. Making a demo - albeit from what we already have - that would actually prove a point and illustrate what the game feels like would require extra time, which we can't afford at the moment.

[b]"Why we haven't posted devlogs up until this point?"[/b]
Our team is very small and posting requires time we wanted to invest into progressing with development instead.
